title: SkillIndexRecord
description: PostgreSQL + pgvector runtime index row built from skill.yaml (name, description, version, metadata). Primary runtime source for Discovery cards. Not a dump of full SKILL.md. Rebuildable by CI.

description.description: Card text injected into context for relevant skills — the main runtime payload from the index

embedding.description: pgvector embedding over name + description (+ searchable metadata); omitted in some API projections

locator.description: Where Skill Resolver Service loads the full package (lfs | blob)

index_ready.description: True only after embed + upsert succeeded; Discovery must ignore false
